lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: قَرَأتُ كُلَّ الدَّواوين — هَل تَجرُؤُ عَلى مُنافَستي؟
lines.english: I have read every divan — do you dare to compete with me?

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: المُتَنَبّي قالَ: عَلى قَدرِ أَهلِ العَزم تَأتي العَزائِم
lines.english: Al-Mutanabbi said: According to the people of resolve, so come the great deeds

lines.speaker: npc
lines.arabic: هَل أَنتَ مِن أَهلِ العَزم؟ أَثبِت ذَلِك!
lines.english: Are you among the people of resolve? Prove it!
